caption: Unpopular opinion: short games are better games. Agree or disagree? #hottake #shortgames #portal #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: short games are better games.

Portal takes about three hours and nobody calls it too short. Every single room matters. Super Metroid can be finished in an afternoon and is still a masterpiece. Length is not value. Assassin's Creed Odyssey asks for 100 hours. Most players never see the ending. Agree?
